scope.physics: Magnetostatics, 2D/plane, A_z scalar potential; B = curl A
domains: Coils represented by impressed J_z or circuit current

modules.name: mesh
modules.goal: Minimal triangle mesh generator and IO
features: C-core parametric geometry (outer/inner yoke, limbs, gap)
Structured block mesher + simple Delaunay for transitions
Entities: nodes [x,y], elements [n1,n2,n3, regionId], regions (material, coil tag), boundaries (Dirichlet/Neumann)

modules.name: materials
features: Linear: ν = 1/μ
Nonlinear: tabulated BH -> μ(B) -> ν(B) with safe interpolation and slope limiting

modules.name: assembly
modules.goal: Assemble K(A) and RHS f for A_z
features: Element stiffness Ke = ∫(ν (∇N)(∇N)^T) dΩ with 1-point eval for linear triangles
Source: J_z via area-weighted load vector
Dirichlet BCs on outer boundary (A=0 or vector potential offset)
Neumann BCs (mag insulation) implicit via no-flux on boundary edges

modules.name: nonlinear_solver
features: Fixed-point or Newton-Raphson on ν(B): iterate A -> B -> ν(B) -> reassemble
Damping/line search and convergence on ||ΔA||/||A|| and energy residual
Optional PCG inner linear solve with Jacobi/ILU preconditioner

modules.name: postprocess
features: Per-element B = [ dA/dy, -dA/dx ]
Compute |B|, energy ∫(1/2) B·H dΩ, flux in legs, inductance via W = 1/2 L I^2
Forces (optional): Maxwell stress on gap boundary segment

modules.name: api
features: solve_c_core(params) -> {A_field, B_field, qois, mesh}
Grid sampling helper to map {A,B} to uniform grids for comparison with DL

modules.name: dl_integration
features: mc_dropout_predict(problem) -> μ(x), σ(x)
pinn_residual(problem, μ) -> r(x) for magnetostatics
QoIs from μ with uncertainty via MC aggregation

modules.name: hybrid_controller
modules.goal: Pick DL or FEM at case level (no patching)
features: Compute scalar scores: mean(σ), mean(r), or percentile
Decision: if score < τ -> return DL μ; else run FEM and return FEM result
Optional blend: report both with flags for audit

modules.name: validation
features: Uniform μ benchmark (no current) -> A ≈ 0
Linear material: compare against high-res reference (mesh refinement study)
C-core inductance vs gap length curve sanity check
Convergence of nonlinear loop across BH curve
